Mahindra aims for over 50% share in small pickup market by FY27

Mahindra & Mahindra aims to capture over 50% market share in the small pickup segment by the fiscal year 2027. The company currently holds a 46% share in this segment as of July. This projection is supported by the expected performance of its 1.1-tonne CNG Veero model. Additionally, Mahindra plans to introduce an electric version of the Veero soon.
